text: Select: chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Source: docs, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id, compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123890', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Sort: chembl_id ASC, compound_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC. Deduplication: Return distinct rows.
